o.en: Scan file to find supplementary overrides (the file can be compressed since dpkg 1.15.5). See deb-extra-override(5) for more information on its format.
Use a pattern consisting of *_all.deb and *_arch.deb, or *_arch.deb if --no-implicit-arch has been specified, instead of scanning for all debs.
Do not implicitly add architecture all binary packages when specifying --arch. Supported since dpkg 1.23.6.
Only generate file hashes for the comma-specified list specified (since dpkg 1.17.14). The default is to generate all currently supported hashes. Supported values: md5, sha1, sha256.
Include all found packages in the output.
Add an X-Medium field containing the value id-string (since dpkg 1.15.5). This field is required if you want to generate Packages.cd files for use by the media access method of dselect.
Show the usage message and exit.
